question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

Rina’s house is at __a stone’s throw__ from the school.
solution:
The correct answer is: **A very short distance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"at a stone's throw"** means a very short distance. (बहुत कम दूरी पर)

 
 
• **Example: **The park is just **a stone's throw** from my house.
 
 
 
• **"A very short distance"** refers to something that is very close or near in proximity. (बहुत कम दूरी)
 
 
• **Example: **The grocery store is **a very short distance** from here.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A very long distance** (बहुत लंबी दूरी)

 
 
• **Example:** The nearest hospital is a very long distance from this village.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Next to** (बगल में)
 
 
• **Example:** My office is next to the coffee shop.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Not very close to** (बहुत पास नहीं)
 
 
• **Example:** The airport is not very close to the city center.
